title: California Fires: MQ-9 Reaper takes off for wildfire support mission
description: A U.S. Air Force MQ-9 Reaper remotely piloted aircraft from the 163d Attack Wing, California Air National Guard, takes off from March Air Reserve Base, California, Aug. 1, 2018, to provide support for civil authorities battling wildfires in Northern California. The MQ-9 provides first responders with a real time look at where and how a fire is burning. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Senior Airman Crystal Housman)
